component.name: lightmime
component.summary: Sync Philips Hue lights with your screen

description.p: lightmime captures your screen and colours the lights of a Philips Hue entertainment area to match it, the way Hue Sync does on other systems. It streams over the bridge's Entertainment API, so the lights follow the picture with low latency.

A small window pairs with the bridge, picks the area and tunes brightness, smoothing and saturation; a tray icon starts and stops syncing. Optionally, it shows up in Home Assistant over MQTT, or runs headless as a systemd user service.

It is made for Wayland: the screen is captured through the desktop's screen-cast portal and PipeWire, on GNOME, KDE Plasma and wlroots compositors such as Sway and Hyprland. X11 works too. No Hue Sync Box and no Hue account are needed; lightmime only talks to the bridge on your local network.
